description_for_human: Discover real estate events like open houses and garage sales near you.
description_for_model: Flypost Ask provides read-only access to discover real estate events (open houses, garage sales, estate sales, etc.) based on geographic location and optional date ranges. Use this plugin to help users find events near them or at specific addresses. The API supports two endpoints: /v1/events/near for location-based search with optional date filtering, and /v1/events/{event_id} for retrieving specific events. Public access provides approximate locations; brokerage-scoped access with brokerage_id provides full details.
